meta.title: Reserved words in paths are not prepended with 'r#'
meta.fix_ref: rust-lang/rust-analyzer#17037 (internal: improve `TokenSet` implementation and add reserved keywords)
meta.build_notes: GitHub release assets rust-analyzer-aarch64-apple-darwin.gz of the weekly tags 2024-04-15 and 2024-04-22; git tag --contains puts the fix first in 2024-04-22. The sysroot is the local rustup toolchain (rustc 1.98.1).
meta.notes: Paths built by auto-import printed module names that are reserved keywords (priv, a keyword reserved for future use) without the r# prefix; the fix adds the reserved keywords to the keyword set used when printing names.

settings_note: The issue names no settings; the session keeps checkOnSave off (native analysis only).

files.note: the issue describes the setup in words only (modules named with reserved words such as priv, used through r#priv, auto-imported); a module r#priv with a struct S used unqualified in main
a binary crate around the snippet (package name, version, edition 2021)

repro.steps: Open src/main.rs. S is used unqualified in main (line 5, character 12); apply the auto-import assist (Import ...). Reported: the imported path names the module 'priv' instead of 'r#priv'. Probe: the edited text must have no parse error that the original did not have.
